name: mulin-creator
description: Operates MuLiN Creator — opens projects, reads and edits POUs and ladder, manages variables and tasks, builds, and downloads to the device. Tools are available immediately; the Creator window is found each time a tool is called, and several open windows are told apart by project.

interface.shortDescription: Operate a running MuLiN Creator from your AI client
interface.longDescription: Opens projects, reads and edits POUs and ladder, manages variables and tasks, builds, and downloads to the device. Tools are available immediately — the Creator window is found each time a tool is called, and several open windows are told apart by which project they have open. Windows only.
defaultPrompt: Open my project in MuLiN Creator and list its POUs.
Show the ladder in this POU and explain what it does.
Build the project and download it to the device.
